strings.tl: Hey, young'un. [1]Go take a look in the Governor's Office. There's an interesting fella in there.
Interesting, my foot. He just put me in a foul mood. Still, he's a rare guest, that's for sure. // [1]But how in hell did that bastard get in here?
Hell if I know. Lately there's nothin' but stuff an old geezer like me can't make sense of.
